how_to: youtubeChannelId: the SDR YouTube channel ID (starts with UC). With this set, the dashboards find the current live stream on their own every time it restarts; nothing else to change. youtubeLiveLink: only a fallback if the channel ID is ever blank. deskLive: true while a meteorologist is on air (red flashing LIVE), false when off air. deskNote: optional line shown while live, e.g. Tracking storms west of Greenville. aiChatUrl: the chat server address (https://….workers.dev) — type off to use only the built-in answers. chatMode: auto (answers go out right away, labeled SDR Forecast Desk) or review (a meteorologist sends every answer from desk.html). Commit, and dashboards update within 2 minutes. sponsors: for each section (ski, beach, hunt) type the sponsor name, optionally a logo image link and their website; leave blank to show nothing. Never paste the stream key here.
